{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Padawan, in my time I have made more mistakes than there are sandfleas on a wild bantha.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
'''Sandfleas''', also known as '''sand fleas''', were small creatures native to desert climates, including those on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. They often lived within the fur of [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]], making it seem likely that they inhabited the planets of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] as well. Larger [[Species/Legends|species]] of sandflea supposedly made good pets.

==Behind the scenes==
Different sources have shown different spellings for the sandflea. In the short novel ''[[Galaxy of Fear: Eaten Alive]]'', it is spelled as "Sand Flea", while in ''[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]'', it is spelled as one word.
